adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a `raw_html` cook_method where `Post#cook` returns `raw` unchanged (`app/models/post.rb`, added `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). `TopicEmbed.import` sets `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` when creating posts from imported feed/article HTML (`app/models/topic_embed.rb`), and that imported `contents` is not sanitized (only URL absolutization via Nokogiri; no stripping of `<script>`, event handlers, or `javascript:` URIs). The embed view then renders this with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (`app/views/embed/best.html.erb`), which will output attacker-controlled HTML verbatim, enabling stored XSS for feed/remote imported content.
